body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original Snowdrop T5 2008 compact three-door coupe/hatch game body sprite sheet for a 2994 salvage world. Reference only worn handpainted style and eight-view layout, NOT its hatch design. Distinct rounded sloping roof compact coupe with a very LARGE DARK GLASS hatch tailgate, broad rounded shoulders, long single side door and small rear side window; four-seat proportions, modest standard trim, NO spoiler or body kit. Worn pale sage green paint with charcoal lower bumpers and muted rose repair patches. Original slim horizontal front lights, short stacked oval rear lamps alongside glass hatch. No logos, badges, letters or exact manufacturer identity. Eight isolated views in4columns x2rows on wide3:1 transparent canvas. Top: front, frontquarter noseRIGHT, fullside noseLEFT, rearquarter noseLEFT. Bottom: rear, rearquarter noseRIGHT, fullside noseRIGHT, frontquarter noseLEFT. Exactly one door handle per side; same car allviews. No tires, rims or wheels; wheel arches fully transparent and open to bottom, NO black backing or suspension. Runtime supplies tires. Low game camera, no scenery or ground/shadows. Clean genuine transparent alpha outside silhouettes, clear margins, no cropping or overlap.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Snowdrop T5 2008 compact hatch LHD dashboard game overlay. Large BLANK opaque black instrument binnacle on LEFT x210..790,y450..680 in1983x793canvas; NO painted gauges, numbers or dials, runtime supplies instruments. Absolutely NO steering wheel, steering column, hands, text or logos. Entire windshield above dash genuinely transparent, thin sideposts at far edges only, no roof crossbar/scenery. Dashboard lower half, straight-on driver's camera. Original fictional design not exact manufacturer replica, clean alpha edges.
